profiles.subject: Core integer source programs through the foundation differential lane
profiles.execution_witness: The source program is admitted and both Wasm modes finish with the expected result and positive execution-step metrics. The actual CLI report has no per-operator trace: record the source operators and the output-discriminating witness separately, and do not claim direct operator tracing. For preserved_prefix_multiple, at least two untouched prefix values survive in order before the result.
profiles.notes: A cell is not reached from its template or AST tag. Rejection/exhaustion counts do not contribute to semantic reach.

profiles.subject: F32 numeric-graph operator interactions through the experiment differential lane
profiles.execution_witness: The checked graph contains the required operation nodes and the L3 reference reports all checked nodes evaluated on a normal result. Record select/index branches from the concrete input bits and output-discriminating values. L4 exposes no per-node trace, so its witness kind is a successful comparison of those exact inputs/outputs, not an asserted internal trace.

unsupported.reason: The existing seeded campaign calls run_legs without a ParamSnapshot; this matrix deliberately does not infer snapshot support from another test path.

profiles.notes: FP-class labels are bound to explicit input/result bit-pattern witnesses in the receipt. Preserve the #38 reference and observation relation.

kill_rule: Count a kill only when the intended property fails for the same retained case and execution that reached the mutant divergence. Compile failures, panics, and unrelated mismatches are not kills.
